Data.String: Esterification (D-008, D-041): R-401 reactive distillation on Amberlyst-15 packing at about 351 K, 98 % conversion (ASSUMED); ethanol to lactic acid ratio held by the make-up on P-403.
C-401 at 20 kPa(a), reflux ratio 1 (ASSUMED, D-009); overhead ethyl lactate, ethanol and water to C-402; residue about 3.1 t/h at about 423 K, sent hot (traced) to anaerobic digestion off-plot.
Relief valves PSV-4105 and PSV-4206 and the vacuum pump exhausts to the vent header (ethanol, D-012); flammable area for area classification.
pnb plants & bytes GmbH, Aachen, Germany
